confirmation.significance: independent futures; paired one-sided sign test; Holm across all roots and four metrics
confirmation.confidence_note: paired bootstrap probability(mean oriented gain > 0); mowers are oriented as fewer is better
confirmation.tick_definition: extra survival on paired losses only; winning completion times are descriptive and never rewarded for being longer

selection_budget.selection: one lexicographic terminal win/wave/tick/mower challenger among student-representable plant/wait actions per root; screen data only
selection_budget.future_independence: confirm namespace disjoint from screen; common world/search seeds within each root
selection_budget.cost_selection: cheapest actual screening challenger/student branch CPU first; preserve 16 independent futures; reserve 500 seconds for exports, training, evaluation and final gates

step_resolution.rule: min(registered upper bound, epochs * ceil(actual training rows / batch size)); all other settings unchanged

paired_evaluation.interval: existing pvz_promotion paired Newcombe method 10, 95%; retains uncertainty on unanimous outcomes
paired_evaluation.deployment_note: Feasibility experiment only; no promotion certificate, default or qc changes.

cost.reference_engine: deploy2 (engine used by the frozen qc round); task53 collection uses required deploy3
cost.scope: Per-point branch CPU includes native short-leaf and true-terminal teacher work. Shared replay/startup, off-panel pilot, training and evaluation overhead is retained in the total ledger, not silently omitted.

value_ranking_pairs.note: same seed/root/future/kind; metrics kept separate; wave/tick/mower preferences are never substituted for binary won labels
